requested_items.objective: Measure Nangate45 PPA for the canonical direct-port sixteen-router segmented mesh without synthetic harness logic.

expected_result.reason: The compact aggregate target cannot accept endpoint workload activity and includes synthetic boundary logic.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Require canonical source identity, a logic-free functional wrapper, all sixteen routers, the explicit 8962-pin perimeter gate, complete PPA, timing feasibility, retained routed artifacts, and isolated flow identity. Debug-counter pins, endpoints/SRAM, and HBM/DRAM remain excluded.
